title: Professional native-first synthesis and DSP
scope: Synthesizer sound generation, DSP fidelity, quality qualification and cross-host rendering; complements docs/song-rollout.md instead of replacing its Song-specific stages.
mission: Deliver professionally viable editable instruments that sound correct in native desktop/mobile production and natively in pre-programmed, while retaining a compatible web studio wherever technically feasible.

platform_policy.web: maintain_when_feasible; never constrain native audio quality to Web Audio or web packaging limits
platform_policy.professional_quality_gate: native reference implementations must pass acoustic and CPU benchmarks even if web support requires an explicit degraded mode
platform_policy.portability: portable patch/automation/event semantics with host-specific DSP implementations verified by reference fixtures
platform_policy.real_time: avoid allocation, blocking I/O, locks and GC-sensitive work in audio callback
platform_policy.backwards_compatibility: One current .premidi model; update current fixtures/examples and remove obsolete readers when consolidating. Do not add migrations for hypothetical saved archives; version changed semantics only as required by the current portable contract.
platform_policy.data_storage: store audio bytes as external assets; keep .premidi files declarative and inspectable
platform_policy.current_preview: Windows 11 x64 portable folder ZIP only; retain macOS/Linux architecture but defer their preview distributions

shared_interface_contract.rule: The same applicable sound processor has the same definition, controls, illustration, bypass, preset, preview and edit semantics in every context. Adapters supply data, source/time mapping, mutation/history and permissions, not another editor.
shared_interface_contract.vocal_source_policy: A vocal Clip remains external recorded audio. Do not require conversion to a Beat or synthesis to unlock common effects.
permitted_source_differences: Oscillators, harmonic partials and generated noise belong to synthesized sources.
Key/velocity zone mapping, note-follow, one-shot/gate and strum belong to triggered sampled instruments.
Source waveform, trim, clip position and source-time mapping belong to recordings; reusable waveform tools are shared where meaningful.
Synth note ADSR and continuous-clip fades have different triggers; explain these differences through capability metadata while sharing applicable processors.
forbidden_shortcuts: Hide a common effect only because the source is vocal
Flatten editable effects into WAV to claim parity
Remove existing controls or illustrations to make inventories match
Add legacy migrations for hypothetical user archives
shared_interface_contract.transaction_rule: One gesture -> ephemeral preview -> one undoable commit in the selected document; cancel leaves the authored patch and immutable source bytes unchanged.
shared_interface_contract.physical_instance: soundInspector.js owns one sound-inspector-frame and one control-node map. Beat, Freeform and vocal adapters move that same node; mount never clones a second desktop Inspector. Beat listeners are owner-guarded and adapter handlers clear on ownership change.
shared_interface_contract.processor_owner: recordedAudio.js shares sampled/vocal processing; synth and recorded hosts consume the same order/bypass contract. C++ executes the corresponding per-channel order, preserving source articulation/pan and explicit delay-send ownership.
shared_interface_contract.editor_buttons: editorWorkspace.js uses one uiIcons.js SVG factory and class-based history/Sound control dimensions for every context; prefixed element IDs cannot change sizing or icon fonts.
shared_interface_contract.parameter_owner: src/dsp/parameters.js: frozen source-aware parameter authority; soundParameterAdapter.js maps stable musical IDs to context storage paths. Controls, validation, modulation/automation and illustration axes consume derived projections.
shared_interface_contract.chain_owner: src/dsp/processing-chain.js defines the bounded current chain, stable IDs and effective bypass; processingChainUI.js is mounted once by the canonical soundInspector.js for all source contexts. UI edits use context-owned history, never copied waveform assets.

capability_audit.current: Two oscillator slots, four basic waveforms plus 32-partial harmonic synthesis, source noise, oscillator levels/octaves/detune and ADSR.

capability_audit.title: Articulation, levels and sample identity
capability_audit.current: Synth ADSR; sampled audio attack/release, transpose/gain/pan; note follow, one-shot, strum and dynamics preservation; sample roots and velocity selection.
capability_audit.gap: Vocal fades use different names/ranges/defaults; sample normalization and voice gain differ from clip gain. Document source-specific triggers while sharing processor definitions and level semantics.

capability_audit.title: Filter and parametric EQ
capability_audit.current: One four-type resonant filter; synth cutoff sweep and tone LFO. Sample/vocal filter bypass behavior differs in UI.
capability_audit.gap: No production parametric EQ found; need editable bands, shelves, slopes and consistent bypass. Extra filter topologies remain linked to SYN-012.

capability_audit.title: Distortion and source noise
capability_audit.current: Shared tanh drive curve with 4x Web Audio oversampling; synth noise amount/decay. Tone/drive panels and illustrations exist.
capability_audit.gap: Missing input trim, dry/wet, selectable shapers, output compensation policy, noise color and bandwidth. Oversampling configuration alone is not listening or aliasing qualification.

capability_audit.title: Pitch motion, tremolo and tone motion
capability_audit.current: Bend shapes, glide, delayed vibrato and tremolo on synth/sample/vocal paths; tone motion exposed and executed on synths.
capability_audit.gap: Shared audio movement UI omits tone/toneRate. Sample/vocal render paths do not schedule a tone LFO, although the movement object can carry its fields. A field accepted in JSON is not a working feature.

capability_audit.title: Assignable modulation matrix
capability_audit.current: Synth-only maximum 16 routes; sine LFO, independent ADSR, velocity and key tracking; six destinations: oscillator pitch/level pairs, cutoff and pan; signed depth/polarity/smoothing.
capability_audit.gap: Samples explicitly reject general routes; vocals lack route storage/editor. Broaden audio-relevant destinations and define per-note versus per-clip timing without artificial vocal velocity/key tracking.

capability_audit.title: LFO shapes, sync, followers, randomness and macros
capability_audit.current: Fixed-rate sine movement and modulation; per-note LFO onset and route smoothing exist.
capability_audit.gap: Missing selectable shapes, beat sync, phase/retrigger modes, envelope followers/sidechains, deterministic random/steps and user macros.

capability_audit.title: Automation and parameter gestures
capability_audit.current: Two-point exponential synth cutoff automation plus captured note/source phase; Beat and Freeform editing paths exist.
capability_audit.gap: Not general multipoint automation; no equivalent sample/vocal automation. Need common targets, curve editing, gesture recording, override state and phase-correct seek/loop/live edits.

capability_audit.title: Delay and reverberation
capability_audit.current: Synths and vocals have mix/time/feedback delay; sampler UI/browser/native sample plan have no delay. Use in Beat explicitly leaves delay behind.
capability_audit.gap: Close sample delay parity first; then tempo sync, feedback tone, ping-pong and shared algorithmic reverb with bounded tails.

capability_audit.title: Compression, gate, de-essing and limiting
capability_audit.current: No implementation found in the audited production sound path.
capability_audit.gap: Need compressor, expander/gate, frequency-selective de-esser and limiter, with sidechain routing and gain-reduction feedback. Sample dynamics preservation is not compression.

capability_audit.title: Chorus, flanger, phaser and creative modulation effects
capability_audit.current: No implementation found in the audited production sound path.
capability_audit.gap: Vibrato/tremolo do not substitute for these processors. Add common chorus, flanger, phaser, auto-pan and ring/frequency-shift processors with shared UI and bounded feedback.

capability_audit.title: Effect order, bypass, sends and parallel routing
capability_audit.current: Synth and recorded-audio paths use fixed processing order; synth/vocal delay may use session-owned shared buses.
capability_audit.gap: No user-editable ordered effect chain, general sends, parallel chains or per-processor bypass/recall found. Distinguish clip, Sound, Instrument and bus ownership.

capability_audit.title: Independent pitch, time and formants
capability_audit.current: Sample/vocal transpose changes playback rate and therefore duration. Vocal UI recalculates length after transpose.
capability_audit.gap: No independent stretch, formant-preserving pitch, independent formant shift or scale-based monophonic pitch correction found.

capability_audit.title: Waveform, sampling and source regions
capability_audit.current: Vocal waveform with source-time lead trim/onset suggestion; sample source excerpts, pitch roots and velocity selection; short compatible WAV vocals can reuse one external asset.
capability_audit.gap: Need unified source-region editing, end trim/fade handles, reverse and sampler sustain loops/crossfades; complete velocity-zone editing. Keep current four-second excerpt and asset limits until explicitly replaced.

capability_audit.title: Stereo and gain staging
capability_audit.current: Pan, recording gain, Sound gain and Instrument volume; Beat/Freeform gain-stage illustration; measured scope.
capability_audit.gap: Vocal editor lacks the canonical overview/stage UI. Add stereo width/mid-side with real stereo inputs, mono-safe behavior and explicit gain ownership.

capability_audit.title: Presets, reuse and undo
capability_audit.current: Beat/Freeform share Sound catalog/save helpers and canonical patch edit callbacks. Vocal edits have Song undo and immutable external recording assets.
capability_audit.gap: Vocal editor has no identical sound preset/audition surface. Conversion currently changes gain/envelope interpretation and omits delay; add portable shared processing presets and preserve all applicable edits.

capability_audit.title: Educational control and illustration parity
capability_audit.current: Separate modules and combined-follow view reuse controls and illustration path linking; references are distinct from measured scope.
capability_audit.gap: Retain this design for all added effects. Every applicable control needs a meaningful interactive illustration, synchronized copies, explicit inactive reason and accessible precise editing.

capability_audit.title: Host quality and portable playback
capability_audit.current: Web and native sample/vocal planners implement existing filters, drive, pitch motion, envelopes and vocal delay; current tests cover selected behavior.
capability_audit.gap: This audit did not measure audio quality or physical Windows behavior. Qualify each new processor in live playback, audition, WAV and current-format projects; game reader parity remains SYN-020.

tasks.title: Consolidate parameter and capability definitions
acceptance: Replace duplicated definitions with one parameter authority used by validation, controls, modulation, automation and illustrations; do not add a second mirrored registry.
Declare stable IDs, units, defaults, ranges, interpolation, bypass and context applicability for each existing field; keep serialization mapping in context adapters.

Record source-only differences separately from shared post-source processing. Synth ADSR and clip fades retain explicit trigger contracts; opening an existing sound never silently rewrites its authored values.
Capability metadata distinguishes implemented, unsupported, inactive and source-only. Reject unsupported non-default processing rather than accepting inaudible state.
verification: Focused validation and edit tests for defaults, boundary values and mixed multi-axis transactions.

completion_evidence.result: Stable parameter IDs and source-aware ranges/defaults/units/interpolation/bypass/trigger/capability metadata, with cached derived projections and no mirrored UI range registry.

Factory sound preservation; shared endpoint acceptance/rejection for synth/sample/vocal; source-only/unsupported/inactive states; valid multi-axis vocal edits; recording modulation graphs cannot offer oscillator or note-derived controls.

tasks.progress_note: Implemented and verified at the parameter/data layer. One frozen authority defines current Sound controls and recorded-source variants; synth/sample/vocal validators, factories, ordinary controls, quick controls, routing choices and graph handles derive from it. Opening/inspecting factory sounds preserves authored values. Source-only controls, inactive processing, unsupported fields, filter bypass, articulation triggers and current modulation applicability are explicit. Physical editor/host observation remains in SE-02/SE-17.

acceptance: Beat, Freeform and Song vocal selection mount the same Inspector chrome, control modules, overview, measured scope, level/pan, audition, preset actions and modules/combined preference.
Vocal adapter supplies clip identity, immutable asset, source-time viewport, context capabilities and Song mutations. It does not assemble another collection of knobs or illustrations.
Keep waveform/trim as a contextual source slot. Existing synth oscillators, rack actions and sample mapping remain available in their meaningful source contexts.
Preview is ephemeral; one committed gesture creates one correct Beat or Song undo step. Preserve focus; dispose old scopes/listeners and ignore stale decode/audition callbacks on selection change.
verification: Focused context-switch interaction check and existing soundInspectorCore/songVocals behavior tests.
tasks.progress_note: All desktop contexts acquire the same physical Inspector frame, controls and core. Vocal chrome no longer assembles modules; its adapter supplies source waveform/trim, mutations and source-aware audition/presets. Focused node-identity test passes; live vocal observation remains pending because the cloud browser cannot read the synthetic import fixture.

tasks.title: Close existing sampled-audio and vocal processing gaps
acceptance: Provide the same delay mix/time/feedback processing on sampled Sounds and vocals, including live/audition/WAV/native tails and serialization.
Implement filter tone motion for sampled Sounds and vocals using the shared movement contract; no accepted field may remain silently ignored.
Use consistent shared processor defaults, bypass, units/ranges, distortion compensation and pan semantics. Source onset/note-off differences are explicit adapters, not accidental divergent formulas.
Define exact effective gain across source normalization, clip/Sound level and Instrument/Track gain. Preserve source loudness intentionally and prevent double gain on conversion.
Match the original trimmed phrase when seeking/looping: do not restart fades, pitch curves or movement phase at the seek boundary.
verification: PCM/plan fixtures for sample versus vocal treatment of the same source, nonzero delay and tone motion, bypass, short fades, seeks and tails.

completion_evidence.result: Resumed clip envelope matches original attack/sustain/release values; glide/bend and sine phase use original Clip age; modulation smoothing history matches full recurrence within 2e-6.

K-rate source-travel oracle at 8000/48000 Hz includes transpose, glide, bend, delayed vibrato and backward seeks; original pitch knots and immutable source data are retained. Browser scheduling uses integrated source offset and remaining buffer content; transport seeks retain the control-quantum phase.

Same-source sampled/vocal fixture remains PCM-identical at 22050 Hz. A cropped silent excerpt under upward pitch motion cannot emit a loud signal located after its source-time endpoint; excludes the final interpolation footprint from the fixture.

Browser-compatible OfflineAudioContext: ongoing effectful seek maximum difference 1.66893e-5; ended-Clip echo 6.46791e-7 at 24000 Hz. Native sampled/vocal PCM difference 0 at 22050 Hz with nonzero filter sweep; sweep changes PCM by 0.813198 peak. Native page rebase preserves sample/vocal sweep and cutoff automation clocks. Cache invalidation/bounds/cancellation and vocal-only voice/echo retirement pass.

tasks.progress_note: Current vocal processing parity is implemented: shared filter sweep, tone/drive/movement/delay, original-age source/pitch/envelope/modulation, stateful browser seek continuations and echo tails, live-edit replacement/cancellation, and native current packet 13. Routine and focused data/DSP checks pass. Pages deployment succeeded. The public desktop loads with one Inspector DOM frame; real vocal UI observation is blocked by cloud-browser fixture file access. Physical Windows listening remains unqualified.

source_clock_contract.pitch_owner: src/dsp/expression.js: full-Clip Float32 pitch knots, vibrato onset/gain and original-time interpolation
source_clock_contract.source_position: Accumulate playbackRate * 2^(detune/1200) over 128-frame host control quanta; use the original Clip gate to evaluate progress. Source seconds and Song/wall seconds remain separate.
source_clock_contract.web_transport: src/hosts/web/timeline-clock.js aligns virtual Song time zero to a render-quantum boundary on initial playback and seeks. Initial overlapping source windows are prepared before choosing the audible start time, outside the lookahead scheduler.
source_clock_contract.bounds: Eight cached control clocks with sparse checkpoints every 256 control quanta; no asset copies, audio callback allocations or sample-sized control arrays. Existing source/host limits remain.
source_clock_contract.qualification: Focused model and C++ regressions; no physical browser/Windows listening or complete seek PCM equivalence claim.

tasks.title: Share presets and preserve processing through vocal reuse
acceptance: Save/load/copy shared processing on vocals through the same preset surface as sampled Sounds; asset-bearing Sound presets and processing-only presets have explicit scopes.
Use in Beat retains every applicable effect, level, trim, pitch and fade; no delay-loss notice is needed once parity works. Source-trigger changes remain explicit.

Current-format import/export, undo/redo, project reopen and relocation retain processor state and unique asset identity; do not add hypothetical historical migrations.
verification: Existing vocalBeatReuse and Song IO behavior plus an effectful vocal-to-Sound round trip.
tasks.progress_note: Vocal shared preset save/browse uses processing-only presets in the existing dialog/catalog, with no source audio in JSON. Reuse keeps delay, movement, routing, automation, gain/fades and stereo; compatible WAV assets remain linked once. Focused current-format ZIP reuse/rename round trips pass. Real-browser vocal interactions remain unverified because the cloud browser cannot read the synthetic import fixture; physical Windows relocation remains unqualified.

tasks.title: Extend assignable modulation to all sound sources
acceptance: Reuse the current matrix for synth, sampled Sound and vocal post-source parameters, with explicit destinations, depth, polarity, smoothing and clamp rules.
Add applicable gain, filter resonance, effect mix/time and stereo targets; oscillator destinations remain synth-only. Vocal inputs use clip/audio clocks instead of invented note velocity.
Specify base value -> automation -> modulation -> bounds composition. Preserve simultaneous routes, deterministic source phase and bounded CPU at declared route limits.
verification: Portable source/target oracle cases plus audible sample/vocal modulation across playback, preview and export.
tasks.progress_note: M2a adds bounded common resonance and amplitude routes to synth, samples and vocals; native/browser execution, preset filtering and illustration source models share these targets. Effect mix/time and broader stereo destinations remain pending effects-chain ownership under SE-08. Full SE-05 is not complete.

tasks.title: Add professional modulation sources and performance macros
acceptance: LFOs expose sine/triangle/ramp/square, Hz or tempo division, phase, retrigger/free-run policy and smoothing. Note/clip/Song clocks remain stable through seek and loop.
Add envelope follower and selectable audio sidechain with attack/release, deterministic seeded random/sample-and-hold, and editable step modulation.
Provide bounded macro mappings to multiple parameters with min/max/polarity, reset and preset recall through the same Inspector; avoid mandatory beginner/expert modes.
Every source exposes its range, input availability and route impact; missing sidechain inputs fail visibly without silently changing the sound.
verification: Source equations/phase fixtures and focused route/macro editing, save/load and undo scenarios.
tasks.progress_note: Shared sine/triangle/ramp/square LFOs now offer free Hz or tempo divisions from 1/16 note through four bars. Triggered voices resolve the current context tempo at onset without rewriting authored Hz/division settings. Vocal seek reconstruction retains original Clip age. Diagrams use the owning context tempo. Selectable free-run/phase policy, envelope follower/sidechain, seeded random, step sources and macros remain planned; SE-06 is not complete.

tasks.title: Generalize automation beyond two-point synth cutoff
acceptance: Support multipoint clip/Sound/Instrument automation for all continuous automatable parameters and stepped discrete parameters with declared units/interpolation.
Reuse graph editing for insert/move/delete points, curves, gesture recording, bypass/remove and undo. Knobs and illustrations display base, automated and modulated states consistently.
Define shared Beat-source, Freeform Song-time and vocal source-time mapping, including trim, repetition, tempo, seek, loop and render tails.
Define live-edit override/rejoin behavior without resetting sustaining sources; automation and modulation serialize through one current project model.
verification: Independent value/phase oracle plus edited Song seek/loop/export round trips for synth, sample and vocal.
tasks.progress_note: Cutoff automation now supports 2–32 authored points, shared add/remove/numerical and two-axis editing, piecewise exponential interpolation, seek-boundary and tail-hold planning, captured Freeform source phase, and native/browser playback. Native execution storage is bounded to 36 events. Beat/Song serialization retains full curves and tempo-synced movement. Other parameter targets, interpolation/curve modes, gesture recording and override/rejoin policies remain planned; SE-07 is not complete.

tasks.title: Create one editable effects chain and routing model
acceptance: Define one portable ordered processor graph with stable node IDs, add/remove/reorder, per-processor bypass, wet/dry and preset recall.
Expose serial processing plus bounded parallel chains/sends and sidechain inputs; distinguish per-voice, per-Sound/clip, Instrument/Track and shared-bus ownership.
The same processor editor is used wherever a processor is mounted. Shared buses do not leak state between unrelated Sounds or Clips.
Define latency reporting/compensation, tail lifetime, feedback bounds and resource cleanup before exposing routing; parsing/allocation stays off native audio callbacks.
verification: Graph-order, bypass, parallel/send isolation, impulse/tail and undo/serialization fixtures.
tasks.progress_note: The bounded built-in serial lifecycle is implemented: add/remove/restore filter and distortion, retain their authored settings and bypass state, reorder or bypass them, and separately bypass the delay send. Empty and single-stage chains use the same browser/native contract and shared Inspector. General multiple processor instances, wet/dry, parallel sends/sidechains and latency compensation remain open; full SE-08 is not complete.

tasks.title: Add parametric EQ and extend filter editing
